tools.name: birth_form
tools.description: Turn what the user said about their birth (date, time, city, gender; solar or lunar) into the `birth` object the chart tools take, with longitude and time zone filled from the city. Show it to the user to confirm. Free (API key required). Price: free (API key required).

tools.name: bazi_chart
tools.description: BaZi (Four Pillars) chart from birth data: pillars, hidden stems, ten gods, MingGe archetype (one of 55) and title, substance / volatility / rarity scores, structure verdict, favourable and unfavourable elements, shensha, the current luck decade with its score and reasons, and this year. Determinist

tools.name: ziwei_chart
tools.description: Zi Wei Dou Shu natal chart from birth data: soul and body palaces, five-element bureau, twelve palaces with major / minor stars, brightness and four transformations, decade limits, and the patterns the chart forms with their share of all charts. Deterministic engine; nothing is stored. Price: $0.05

tools.name: hepan
tools.description: Synastry (合盘) of two people's birth data for romance, business partnership, friendship or family: overall score and title, six dimension scores with their grounds, cross-chart interactions, cross shensha, ten-god matrix, Zi Wei cross transformations. Deterministic engine; nothing is stored. Price: $

tools.name: bazi_pillars
tools.description: BaZi skeleton only (facts, no judgement): four pillars, hidden stems, ten gods, nayin, life stages, void branches, shensha, and the luck-pillar sequence. For MingGe's archetype, scores and verdicts use bazi_chart. Price: $0.01 per chart.

tools.name: ziwei_board
tools.description: Zi Wei Dou Shu board only (facts, no patterns): twelve palaces with stars, brightness, four transformations and decade-limit ranges. For patterns and their share use ziwei_chart. Price: $0.01 per chart.

tools.name: calendar_convert
tools.description: Convert a date (and optional time): Gregorian, Chinese lunar and stem-branch pillars, the solar term it falls in with exact term times, and true solar time when longitude is given. Price: $0.01 per date.

tools.name: bazi_luck
tools.description: The full BaZi luck curve: all eight luck decades with MingGe's score (with scale), tier and grounds, plus a score for every year. MingGe members' content. Price: $0.15 per chart.

tools.name: bazi_timing
tools.description: Life-event timing from a BaZi chart: time windows by area (marriage, career, wealth, move, health, children, home, parents, peers) with grounds. MingGe members' content. Price: $0.15 per chart.

tools.name: bazi_period
tools.description: MingGe's score and grounds for a given year, month or day of a BaZi chart (annual, monthly, daily fortune), with the solar-term month it reads. Price: $0.05 per period.

tools.name: ziwei_limits
tools.description: Zi Wei Dou Shu limits for a year, month or day: decade, annual, monthly and daily palaces with flying four transformations and notes. Price: $0.10 per period.

tools.name: qizheng_chart
tools.description: Qi Zheng Si Yu (七政四余, Chinese sidereal astrology) natal chart: the eleven luminaries' mansions and degrees, degree lords, benefic and malefic roles, star patterns, life and body lords. Rarely available anywhere else. Price: $0.15 per chart.

tools.name: qizheng_transit
tools.description: Qi Zheng Si Yu transits at a moment (default now) against the natal chart: where each luminary is and what it activates. Price: $0.10 per moment.

tools.name: zeri_pick
tools.description: Date selection (择日): usable days for an event (wedding, engagement, moving in, opening, signing, groundbreaking, travel, seeing a doctor) within a date range, with reasons, excluding days that clash with the person's chart. Price: $0.10 per range.

tools.name: reading_pack
tools.description: Everything for a full BaZi reading in one call: bazi_chart + bazi_luck (all luck decades and years) + bazi_timing (life-event windows). Cheaper than the three separately ($0.35). Price: $0.30 per chart.

tools.name: verify_vectors
tools.description: Public cross-check cases against external charting sites (BaZi, Zi Wei, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men, Liu Yao, Plum Blossom): ready-to-run tool calls with the expected results, so you can verify MingGe yourself. Same input and engine version give byte-identical results. Free (API key required). Price: free (A

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: The school / rule options each tool accepts (Qi Men centre palace and hidden stems, Liu Ren month general and noble person, day boundary, true solar time…): groups, ids, defaults and what each means. Free (API key required). Price: free (API key required).

tools.name: my_charts
tools.description: List the user's saved charts in MingGe (id, label, birth summary). Pass an id as `chart_id` to the chart tools instead of `birth`. Needs a connected MingGe account (OAuth at mingge.org/mcp/account). Free, rate-limited. Price: free (API key required).

tools.name: cast_liuyao
tools.description: Liu Yao (六爻) divination for one question: six lines by coin toss (default), by time or given manually; original and changed hexagram, six relatives, use god. Deterministic engine: returns the board plus MingGe's full verdict (conclusion, grounds, timing). Verdict text is in Chinese — relay it in the

tools.description: Qi Men Dun Jia (奇门遁甲) chart for the moment of asking: nine palaces with doors, stars, deities and stems, patterns. Deterministic engine: returns the board plus MingGe's full verdict (conclusion, grounds, timing). Verdict text is in Chinese — relay it in the user's language without changing the judge

tools.name: cast_liuren
tools.description: Da Liu Ren (大六壬) lesson for the moment of asking: four lessons, three transmissions, heavenly generals, lesson type. Deterministic engine: returns the board plus MingGe's full verdict (conclusion, grounds, timing). Verdict text is in Chinese — relay it in the user's language without changing the jud

tools.name: cast_xiaoliuren
tools.description: Xiao Liu Ren (小六壬) quick reading for the moment of asking: month / day / hour palaces and the final palace. Deterministic engine: returns the board plus MingGe's full verdict (conclusion, grounds, timing). Verdict text is in Chinese — relay it in the user's language without changing the judgement. N

tools.name: draw_lingqian
tools.description: Draw a temple lot (灵签) — Guanyin, the Matchmaker (Yuelao) or Guan Di. The server draws the number uniformly at random; returns the lot's rank, poem and the classical annotations by topic. Text is in Chinese. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.02 per lot.

tools.name: lexicon
tools.description: Look up a Chinese metaphysics term, star, shensha or pattern: meaning, the condition under which it forms, its share of all charts, and the classical source text. Price: $0.01 per term.

tools.name: almanac_day
tools.description: Chinese almanac (黄历) for a date: day pillars, do / avoid, day officer, solar term, clash. Price: $0.005 per day.

tools.description: Create an account + API key (shown once; includes a small free trial). Save it and configure it as the Bearer token for this MCP server. Free.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_api_key" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
